hotels.description: Set in the idyllic seaside resort town of Discovery Bay, just a 25-minute ferry ride from Central Pier, this five-star resort is a perfect base for those seeking a glimpse of Hong Kong's natural beauty. Satisfy your cravings with the Western and pan-Asian fare at Café bord de Mer & Lounge, then stop by Spa Botanica and indulge in plentiful opportunities for pampering. Positioned on Lantau Island, you're a bus and cable-car ride from the Big Buddha, with verdant Central Park, golden-sand Tai Pak Beach and the shopping and dining of Discovery Bay Plaza closer to hand. Hong Kong International Airport is an easy 25-minute drive, and Hong Kong Disneyland is a short bus ride away for family-friendly fun. When it's time to return to the hotel, the seasonal outdoor pool awaits for a refreshing dip.
